title: Characterization of genetic intratumoral heterogeneity of benign and malignant soft tissue tumors for prediction of genetic aberrations by machine learning.
summary:
The aim of the project is to use forms of machine learning to make a statement about specific genetic aberrations of soft tissue tumors on the basis of image morphological criteria.
In particular, methods from the field of radiomic and deep learning based image analysis are used for this purpose. The sequenced genome of resected tumors and the clinical diagnosis is considered as reference.

interventions.name: retrospective analysis of data: The collected findings, measurement results and all data collected according to the test plan are entered into the test forms. The number and sequence of the planned examinations are taken from the test design and correspond to the routine procedure.

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
Patients of the Tumor Orthopedics of the LMU  with clinical diagnosis of a soft tissue tumor (malignant / benign) and corresponding radiological examinations as well as histopathological findings/ clinical diagnoses.
Exclusion criteria:
- Missing imaging (MRI)
- Missing histopathological findings / clinical diagnosis
